_comment: Reviewed exceptions for high/critical advisories that currently have NO released fix. Production dependencies are never excepted — they are gated separately and hard by `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`. Every entry must carry an advisory id, the affected package, a reason and a review date; the gate fails on an entry that is no longer needed, so this list can only shrink. See docs/RELEASE_GATE.md.

exceptions.reason: Stack-exhaustion denial of service in brace expansion. Reached only through the ESLint toolchain (eslint-config-next → @next/eslint-plugin-next → fast-glob → micromatch → braces) and never by the running application, which does not import any of it. The advisory lists no patched release: every published braces version (<= 3.0.3) is affected, so no dependency bump can clear it.
